facts.fact: Togo's Loi n° 2022-009 of 24 June 2022, adopted by the National Assembly and promulgated by the President, amends articles 2, 3 and 6 of Loi n° 2018-026 of 7 December 2018 on cybersecurity and the fight against cybercrime.
facts.system: Loi n° 2018-026 sur la cybersécurité et la lutte contre la cybercriminalité
